items.text: Service
Mortgage and financing studied with real numbers, together with our financial broker.
The mortgage, studied before you fall in love with a flat.

Knowing how much you can finance, at what monthly payment and on what terms saves headaches. We study it with you and with our financial broker, who compares the conditions offered by different lenders.
And when you sell, we check the buyer can pay, so the transaction doesn't fall through on the financing.
Who it's for

Frequently asked questions
What people ask us

items.q: How much do I need saved?
items.a: It depends on the price, the appraisal and your profile. In addition to the part the bank doesn't finance, you need to allow for taxes and purchase costs. We calculate it with real numbers before you start looking.

items.q: Who advises me on the mortgage?
items.a: Our financial broker, with whom we work on transactions that involve financing. We coordinate the whole process with you.

items.q: Is it useful if I've already found the flat?
items.a: Yes. The sooner we study it, the better: that way you'll know what conditions you can commit to in the deposit contract.
